title: metadata-protocol: a package-less direct save of an item a package owns answers 200 and writes a package-less row the item read never serves; the draft save already resolves the owning package (#11087 / #22128)
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): the save door reports success for a write the read never serves. `reach:` the public door `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` with no `?package=`, measured on a booted showcase by the browser pass behind objectstack-ai/objectui#12300 (case 2, two fresh loads), at objectstack `36b2889c`.

Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, splitting out the server half that objectstack-ai/objectui#12300 names ("whether the server should refuse this write is that repo's call, and triage may split it out"). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

- **Setup:** a writable package `com.qa.lanebapp` owns `app/lanebapp_app`, saved with `?package=com.qa.lanebapp`.
- **The write:** `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/lanebapp_app` with `{...app, active: false}` and **no** `?package=` answers 200, "Saved app 'lanebapp_app' (env-wide, state=active)".
- **What is stored:** `sys_metadata` now holds two `lanebapp_app` rows. One is the package row (`active: true`), and the read serves it. The other is a new package-less env-wide row (`active: false`), and the read never serves it.
- **What the read says:** `GET /api/v1/meta/app/lanebapp_app` still reads `active: true` with `_packageId: com.qa.lanebapp`.
- The client half (the console omits `?package=`) is objectstack-ai/objectui#12300. This card is the door's half: any client gets the same silent 200, including the API, the CLI and agents.

## Governing text

- **#22128 (landed, PR #22185 → `3b493184e1`):** "One write-address resolution". `SysMetadataRepository.resolveWriteHead` / `headAt` gives the row a save at an address upserts, "with #11087's draft package inheritance kept". A package-less **draft** save of a package-owned item therefore binds to the owning package.
- **The defect:** the direct (non-draft) save at the same address does not take that resolution. It mints a package-less row beside the package's.

## Direction (triage)

- **One resolution for both save modes.** A package-less direct save resolves its write address the way the draft save does (`headAt`).
  - The item is bound to exactly one package: the save writes that package's row, and the answer names it.
  - The item is bound to more than one package: the save is refused with a typed error naming the candidates, and the remedy is `?package=`.
  - ⛔ Never a 200 that writes a row the item read does not serve.
- An item with no package binding keeps today's env-wide row, unchanged.
- **Clause ②:** this narrows what the door accepts (the ambiguous case is refused), so it is `Clause-②: no`. The card stays in its lane, and owes a contract-tier review before it is queued.
- **Pins:**
  - the write → read round trip: what a package-less save of a single-package item writes is what the item read serves next;
  - the ambiguous case is refused, by code;
  - the package-less-item control is unchanged;
  - the draft-save path's existing pins hold.
- **Existing rows:** package-less rows already minted beside a package's row stay as they are. ⛔ No conversion here. If one is measured served wrongly, that measurement is its own card.

## Grade (triage)

`bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:engine` · `area:studio`, into `pm:queue`. Why p2: a reported success that is false, on the public door, and the reason a console "Disable" shows success while nothing changes. No data is lost. Lane: `packages/metadata-protocol` is `domain:engine` in the domain table.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack: "metadata save without package scope on a package-owned item writes a package-less row the read never serves, answers 200" returned 37 hits. None is open for this shape. The nearest, all closed, are #22128 (the draft-save head resolution), #21638 (a package-less view container saved under a shipped item's name), #21817 (the package-scoped list fallback) and #22057.

Dedupe words: package-less direct save package-owned item; save door unserved row 200; resolveWriteHead direct save; ?package= omitted write.
